name: HUFF
summary: Blow at the mic, tilt for the notes. Ocarina, flutes, clarinet, brass, a didgeridoo, a guitar, a synth lead and a choir, an amp behind them; links to the other boards.
author: willbearfruits
status_note: Installed from the app and ran on a board on 2026-10-19. The breath detector for noisy rooms, the six new models and the amp (2026-10-22) have only run in the simulator so far. Rev E's left knob (the octave) and hand (a mute) are tested in the simulator only: no rev E board has run them.
